common_issues.issue: Inconsistent adoption of React Native Testing
common_issues.cause: Project profile does not explicitly reference the standard or its owner.
common_issues.solution: Attach standard by code to project profile, assign owner and check compliance before change approval.

common_issues.issue: Written standard is not enforceable automatically
common_issues.cause: Some behaviour depends on design decisions and runtime context.
common_issues.solution: Pair automated lint/tests with manual review and recorded acceptance evidence.
